title: When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to require client certificates ("ssl_verify_client on") in a…
description: A vulnerability in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source occurs when configured to require client certificates (ssl_verify_client on) in a non-default stream virtual server, allowing remote attackers to bypass client certificate verification. This issue affects the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. No affected versions or patches are specified. The CVSS score is 4.8, indicating medium severity.
